Alibaba Group Hldg LTD (BABA) Shareholder Ingalls & Snyder Trimmed Its Holding by $303,752; Pekin Singer Strauss Asset Management Continues to Hold Position in Apple (AAPL)
May 9, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Ingalls & Snyder Llc decreased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (BABA) by 4.28% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ingalls & Snyder Llc sold 1,766 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 39,484 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.81 million, down from 41,250 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ingalls & Snyder Llc who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $502.87B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.31% or $0.6 $195.71. About 7.61M shares traded. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% uptrending. It has outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500.
Pekin Singer Strauss Asset Management increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 3114.7% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Pekin Singer Strauss Asset Management bought 31,147 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 32,147 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.44 million, up from 1,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Pekin Singer Strauss Asset Management who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $942.75 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.13% or $0.251 $185.799. About 8.41M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
